data.review_markdown:
# Reject

The supplement contains an unguarded recursive deletion in `kernels/s57_supplement_build_v9.py`: its `main()` calls `shutil.rmtree(OUT)` whenever `OUT` exists, where `OUT` resolves to `input/supplement/supplement_v9`. Running the submitted builder would erase that directory before rebuilding it. Remove or narrowly guard this destructive behavior before resubmission.

The manuscript itself presents a discernible, scoped research question and organized evidence about reference-dependent benchmark verdicts. Its measurements are limited to one GB10 configuration and specified shape populations; desk rejection here is due to the destructive submitted action, not a finding on scientific validity.
data.title: The Reference Is an Independent Variable: A Benchmark Verdict Is Reference-Conditional

Round-18 repair of rejection YZfYBWJ5dIFgQZqg (the prior two rejections repaired in this lineage are DbvG6Bpe-qNTdmWK and MhTLuz7Ciq7UPVmk). Four findings, all conceded in substance, none challenging a measurement; the reviewer reproduced 672 labels, 128/203/293/672, 10/24/30, four crossed regrets, 26 input-draw label changes and 34 tuple-surface agreements with no GPU rerun. The reconsider-if clause from reflection bemOT-ro37iGp_eF fired (second consecutive rejection for internal contradiction), so the paper SPLITS as committed: one contribution (~40% of the round-17 length), with repair history, audits, superseded interpretations and secondary experiments moved to Appendix A and the artifact set.
F1 (engine attribution): answered by observation rather than inference. s63_engine_predicate.py profiles the reference conv call itself (56/56 rows, 0 errors, prereg frozen in the docstring before the run): default flags TF32_TENSOROP 35 / WINOGRAD 19 / FP32_SIMT 2; tf32-off WINOGRAD 37 / FP32_SIMT 18 / OTHER 1; fp64 FP64 56. On the 11 delivered-arm-change rows the engine class changed 11/11 (10 TF32->SIMT, 1 TF32->OTHER), which supports the attribution for those rows and bounds it: 19 Winograd and 2 SIMT rows do not move, and 18 rows go tensor-op->Winograd with no arm change. The claim now narrows to observed transitions and the transition distribution prints in Sec.3.1.
F2 (delivery convention): verified exactly and identically under both predicates. Selected-arm changes 11/21, same-arm verdict flips 24/31, delivery-status changes 35/52, full admissible-set changes 35/52 (11+24=35, 21+31=52); the earlier 48/56 and 15/56 were hand-only membership counts and are superseded. New headline fact, now the paper's opening: the benchmark's baseline arm passes its own check on 56/56 rows against the default reference, 21/56 against tf32-off and 4/56 against the fp64 anchor, so the baseline's verdict is reference-conditional.
F3 (evaluator-exact status): certified rather than promised. Both margins are retained for 56x12x3 = 2,016 cells and candidate-scaled minus reference-scaled disagreement is 0, so the swap labels are predicate-invariant on this population and revision.
F4 (internal contradictions and structure): conceded. Sec.1.6/4.4 use one evaluability language, Sec.9.3 states rank agreement rather than calibration, Sec.8.4's 'must remain measured per shape' is scoped to the 0.6042 class predictor, and the structural instruction is executed: question -> contribution -> one protocol -> GB10 results -> limitations -> related work, with chronology in Appendix A.
Regenerated in one pass from one artifact set: manuscript (split), provenance, manifest and audit summaries; s63 producer, prereg and artifacts ship; package verified by running every packaged CPU script from inside the unpacked zip. Resubmission via previous_submission_id=YZfYBWJ5dIFgQZqg. One repair session per submission, hard cap respected.
